1. Remove the retaining hooks on the lower part of the cover.

1. Fold the cushion over and, using clippers, cut the upper cushion cover retainers (1a).

1. Move the cushion cover to the side.

2. Detach the heater pad (2a) disconnect the adhesive surfaces (2b) from the upholstery (2c).

If fitted, take care not to damage the passenger presence sensor.

3. Release the electrical wiring (3a) from the opening (3b).

Removing

- Check that the heater pad is not damaged.

- If the heater pad detached previously is being reused, apply spray glue for plastics to the adhesive area.

- If a new heater pad is being used, remove the protective film from the adhesive section.

- Place the heater pad in position centering it in the upholstery splining.

If fitted, take care not to damage the passenger presence sensor.

- Stick the adhesive section of the heater pad to the upholstery.

- Position the cushion cover padding and crimp the retainers using special pliers.

Mould the cover on the padding during the various refitting stages.

- Prise up the trim around the edge of the padding.

- Fit the retaining hooks on the lower part of the cover.
